Package gui

Class LiveDashboardController

java.lang.Object
gui.LiveDashboardController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Initializable
public class LiveDashboardController extends Object implements Initializable
Controller for the Live Dashboard view in the BistroNine client application. This class manages a TabPane containing three main live-monitoring views: Active Orders, Waiting List, and Current Diners. It handles the initialization of sub-controllers and triggers data refreshes when users switch between tabs (lazy loading).
